text:
# Close wrap, Fri Oct 23, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:30 PM ET)

**Indexes:** Dow -1.25% (52,209), S&P 500 -0.52% (7,623.86), Nasdaq -0.21% (25,955). Selling broadened beyond the AI trade; chips steadied after Thursday's rout, but staples and financials slipped. S&P and Nasdaq down a second straight week; Dow up on the week. ([Reuters/Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/wall-st-set-open-lower-130848087.html), [Yahoo live](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-dow-sp-500-drop-nasdaq-rises-after-sharp-tech-sell-off-160940864.html))

**Sectors:** Energy hit a record as Brent rose to ~$116 (WTI ~$102) after Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia; XLE +2.6% to $69.32, a 20-day high. Telcos dragged comm services on the SpaceX fourth-carrier report. ([Reuters midday](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/articles/tech-selloff-relents-oil-five-103308077.html)) Feed closes: XLK +0.5%, XLP -1.9%, XLV -1.1%, XLF -1.3%.

**Movers:** T -8.0%, TMUS -7.7%, VZ -1.3%. CCI +9.1% and AMT +4.1%, but both faded from opens of $91.02 and $200.72. SLB +7.1% to $53.05, LMT +2.5% to $604.65, PG -2.1%. AXP -3.7% after results and an "agile and efficient" restructuring comment. RHI +21.8% to $45.90 (first EPS growth since 2022); RNG faded from $98 to $83 after a guide raise. ([Kalkine](https://kalkine.com/news/general-news/earnings-winners-after-q3-reports-what-lifted-robert-half-nyserhi-ringcentral-nyserng-and-more), [Ava/Seeking Alpha](https://ava.fund/news/ringcentral-robert-half-sk-hynix-gain-deckers-moderna-western-digital-fall-23102026))

**After hours:** Quiet Friday, no major covered reports.

**Setup:** About a third of the S&P reports next week: V and AMT 10/27, MSFT, GOOGL and FOMC 10/28, AMZN 10/29, XOM 10/30 BMO. Hyperscaler capex guides decide the AI trade. Retail bought ~$550M of tech this week while institutions sold ([X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2113724052045189215)).

**Swing ideas (long-only)**
- **XLE**: record energy sector, closed at a 20-day high with Brent ~$116. Conf: low. Risk: oil premium collapses on any US-Iran/Houthi de-escalation.
- **RHI**: +21.8% close near the high of day on first EPS growth since 2022 and Q4 guide implying ~30% earnings growth. Conf: low. Risk: staffing is cyclical; big gaps can fade.

Holds unchanged, no re-adds: SLB (+6% from entry), LMT, CCI. New avoid: AXP.

## Weekly scorecard (calls 10/19-10/23, marked to Fri close)
7 up / 7 down / 3 flat (±0.5% = flat), average +0.46% per call vs SPY -0.9% from Mon open. Best: SLB +6.2%, HAL +4.9%, DDOG +4.6%, LMT +4.3%. Worst: CCI -5.5%, TMO re-affirm -2.9%, AMZN -2.8%. Prior-week defensives still up: UNH +9.4%, BLK +2.7%, CCI (10/9) +8.0%; ASML -6.3%.
Paper book (Swing desk, 3:29 PM state): equity $19,046.61, week -$445.37 (core QQQ -$365.55, strategies -$79.82, below Monday base); bench SPY $19,552.18.
